RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of strings
Items Enum: "CanScan"
"CanView"
"CanEdit"
"CanUse"
A list of actions to applied to the tags or the assets grouped by tags.
Possible actions are CanScan , CanView , CanEdit , and CanUse .
string
The name of the permission.
Note: The name must be unique, 255 characters or less, and
alphanumeric. The following special characters are allowed: underscore,
dash, parenthesis, brackets, and colon.
Array of objects
A list of objects (tags or assets) that will have the specified permission
applied to them.
string
The UUID of the permission.
Array of objects
A list of users or user groups that you want the permission applied to.
integer <int64>
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time on which the permissions
was created.
string
The name of the user who created the permission.
integer <int64>
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time on which the permissions
was updated.
string
The name of the user who last updated the permission.

— 400
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered any of the following error conditions:
Incorrect actions: The AllAssets  object type is only compatible with CanView , CanScan ,
or empty permissions. The Tag  object type is only compatible with CanUse  and CanEdit
permissions.
Required fields are missing. Required fields are name , subjects , and objects .
The permission name doesn't meet the requirements.
— 403 Returned if you are not allowed to create permissions.
— 409 Returned if a permission with the same name already exists for your container.
